title: Your AI Should Know When to Ask
description:
Making an AI ask before every click turns you into the robot. Letting it do everything blindly turns one bad action into your problem.

The useful boundary is specific. Valo can require a fresh Allow or Deny before Screen Control acts, even while Codex otherwise has full trust.

Autonomy should remove busywork. It should not remove you.

Valo: https://getvalo.dev
